# [CS039] Request Context Not Propagated (context-propagation-missing)

A handler calls a database or network API with context.Background() instead of the request context.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-400](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/400.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

When the client disconnects or the deadline passes, work started with context.Background() keeps running and holding connections. Pass r.Context() so cancellation propagates.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
rows, err := db.QueryContext(context.Background(), query)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
rows, err := db.QueryContext(r.Context(), query)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [context-propagation-missing]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    context-propagation-missing: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore context-propagation-missing -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** context-propagation-missing
```
